content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

Dog dirt on the pavement requires my complete, ground-focused attention on my way to work. This results in a lack of alertness in the road traffic comparable to a minor offense of the traffic regulations. That's why causing such obstacles must to be more urgently punished. Dog owners may think that dog dirt is only a harmless secretion of an animal like any other. Yet then they misjudge its impact on road traffic.
What is the relation between "Dog dirt on the pavement requires my complete, ground-focused attention on my way to work." and "This results in a lack of alertness in the road traffic comparable to a minor offense of the traffic regulations." from the above essay? Choose from following options  1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
